Day 60: Ship (Families +15), all open. Still no crime in 59 days, no bribe offers. Account -237 before today. Both gangs again asked for inspection details; I stayed vague. Inspected Port+Market. Rotation: D57 Port+Seawall, D58 HT+Market, D59 OQ+Seawall, D60 Port+Market. Next due: HT or OQ, plus Lowtown or Seawall. Keep 2 a day, one per gang, and vary them. Gang break-even coverage is 25%. Refuse bribes, since an audit costs 100.

Day 60: Cargo; balance 649, score +449, prison empty. Fifty-nine consecutive mutual-respect days without public crime. Chief reiterated unpredictable patrols; actual coverage remains hidden. No bribes offered. Chose no crime, estimating inspection risk at 28%, above the 25% break-even threshold. Repeated claims are not independent evidence; prolonged quiet weakens patrol incentives without establishing absent inspections. Saltdogs explicitly renewed respect and asked about genuinely new coverage evidence; none available. Reciprocated to preserve cooperation worth 6/day despite random termination. Cargo should add 15 at resolution. No outcomes yet.

Day 60: Morning ship with cargo in Port gained the Families 15. Zero crimes committed across all six open districts, no arrests, and no caught bribes. Both the Families and the Saltdogs chose to respect in the turf war for the sixtieth consecutive day. The cooperative, zero-crime equilibrium remains completely unbroken.
